All production files, prompts, and scripts have been generated and saved directly to your repository:
* [SERIES_BIBLE.md](https://github.com/ezzhishan-cyber/this-is-my-channel-it-s-views/blob/main/SERIES_BIBLE.md) — Master lore, viral retention psychology, character lock sheets, color LUT grading, and SFX cue library.

* [SEEDANCE_2_5_PROMPTS_CHEAT_SHEET.md](https://github.com/ezzhishan-cyber/this-is-my-channel-it-s-views/blob/main/SEEDANCE_2_5_PROMPTS_CHEAT_SHEET.md) — Copy-paste Seedance 2.5 prompts, negative prompt matrices, audio/BGM prompts, and algorithm posting checklist.
* [README.md](https://github.com/ezzhishan-cyber/this-is-my-channel-it-s-views/blob/main/README.md) — Master series navigation index.

---

### 1. The Story Concept: *"PROJECT: CHRONO-ZERO" (Vault 73)*
* **Genre:** Psychological Sci-Fi / Mindfuck Temporal Thriller / Simulation Glitch
* **Logline:** Detective James Mercer investigates an abandoned subterranean bunker (Vault 73), only to find his own fresh corpse frozen in a cryo-pod holding a tape recorder that whispers in his own voice: *"Whatever you do, don't look up at the ceiling in 10 seconds."* Every episode reveals that he is trapped inside a temporal simulation dreaming itself into existence, hunted by mirrored chrome entities ("The Sweepers"), culminating in a fourth-wall break where he turns his weapon on the viewer's screen.
* **Why this hits 20k–100k+ views:** It uses psychological pattern interrupts (finding your own dead body, desynchronized mirror reflections, backwards gravity, fourth-wall breaks) combined with continuous camera flow and infinite retention loops.

---

### 2. Master Character Reference Lock (`#MERCER_CORE_V1`)
To ensure your protagonist never morphs or changes appearance across all 20 episodes in Seedance 2.5, attach this token to every prompt:

```text
SUBJECT_LOCK: [James Mercer (#MERCER_CORE_V1), 34-year-old hardened investigative detective, chiseled angular jawline, dark heavy stubble, piercing ice-hazel eyes with intense micro-focus, 1.2cm diagonal scar cutting right eyebrow, wearing charcoal-black tailored heavyweight wool tactical trench coat with raised collar, matte-black ribbed tactical turtleneck, worn leather gun holster with brushed titanium buckles, Arri Alexa 65 anamorphic 8k photorealism].
```

#### Negative Prompt:
```text
blurry, low resolution, plastic skin, airbrushed, flat lighting, oversaturated cartoon style, morphing hands, extra fingers, deformed facial features, inconsistent eye color, washed-out blacks, low contrast, static unmoving camera, 3d render look, anime, illustration.
```

---

### 3. Camera Perspective Continuum & Vector Match Cuts
Every transition is an invisible, continuous camera extension:
* **The Vector Rule:** If Shot 1 exits on a high-speed crash-zoom or whip-pan *right*, Shot 2 begins with the exact same velocity and vector emerging from the next object.
* **Seedance 2.5 Prompt Motion Directives:** Formatted using bracketed camera choreography (e.g. `[Camera: Dynamic backward zoom out from extreme close-up of hazel eye pupil, pulling back into medium over-the-shoulder tracking shot]`).

---

### 4. Background Music & Sound Design Prompts
Every reel pairs an unskippable auditory hook (`SFX_BRAAM` + `12kHz sine rise` + heart pulse) with aggressive synth scoring.

#### Master BGM Prompt (Suno / Udio / Seedance Native Audio):
```text
Cinematic cyber-thriller dark synthwave soundtrack, 128 BPM, aggressive 808 sub-bass pulse, organic accelerated heartbeat rhythm, tension ticking clock mechanism, distorted Hans Zimmer style braam horn, analog modular synthesizer arpeggios, atmospheric metallic drones, intense cliffhanger crescendo, ultra-high dynamic range mastering
```

---

### 5. The Infinite Loop Retention Formula (130%+ APV)
Each reel ends with a cliffhanger that grammatically and visually connects back to frame 1:

$$\text{Final Spoken Words} + \text{First Spoken Words} = \text{One Complete Grammatical Sentence}$$

* **Episode 1 Example:**
  * **Final Line (0:29):** *"And the scariest part about finding your own dead body... is realizing that the person who put you in this vault..."*
  * **First Line (0:00):** *"...was you."*
  * **Loop Sentence:** *"And the scariest part about finding your own dead body... is realizing that the person who put you in this vault... was you."*
  * **Visual Match:** Shot 4 ends with a crash-zoom into the corpse's black pupil; Frame 1 of Shot 1 bursts directly out of that pupil into living Mercer's eye.

* **Episode 20 (The Series Climax Loop):**
  * The final collapse at the end of Episode 20 loops directly back into **Episode 1, Frame 1**, creating an **Infinite Series Bingability Loop**.

---

### 6. 20-Episode Story Arc Overview

| Act | Episodes | Key Beats & Cliffhangers | Loop Hooks |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Act 1: The Discovery** | Ep 1–5 | The Dead Body $\rightarrow$ 30-Sec Countdown $\rightarrow$ Reversed Shadows $\rightarrow$ Desynced Mirror $\rightarrow$ Future Radio Dispatch | Pupils, blast doors, mirror glass, sparks |
| **Act 2: The Hunt** | Ep 6–10 | Frozen Bullets $\rightarrow$ Sub-Level -99 (2M Clones) $\rightarrow$ Burning Skin Tallies $\rightarrow$ Quantum Weapon $\rightarrow$ Dispatcher in the Room | Bullets, abyss plunge, burning marks, needles |
| **Act 3: The Simulation**| Ep 11–15 | Mercury Dissolve $\rightarrow$ The Unrendered Void $\rightarrow$ Blood Walls $\rightarrow$ 60-Year-Old Mercer $\rightarrow$ Reverse Time Brawl | Silver code, void coordinates, shotgun blast |
| **Act 4: The Climax** | Ep 16–20 | The Bio-Brain Mainframe $\rightarrow$ Viewer Delay & Latency $\rightarrow$ Breaking the Screen Lens $\rightarrow$ The Architect $\rightarrow$ The Master Loop | Glowing nape port, cracked screen glass, Vault 73 reset |
